slides.headline: Don't hide the damp patch
slides.body: This mistake can sink your sale.
slides.say: Selling in George? Don't hide the damp patch.

slides.headline: Buyers find it anyway
slides.body: At the inspection, or the day they move in.
slides.say: Buyers find it anyway. At the inspection, or the day they move in.

slides.headline: Known defects go in writing
slides.body: Sellers fill in a disclosure form before the sale.
slides.say: And in South Africa, known defects go on a disclosure form. So be upfront.

slides.headline: Fix it, or price it
slides.body: Repair it, or get a quote and let the price reflect it.
slides.say: Fix it, or get a quote and let the price reflect it.
